title: What If Everyone Stopped Eating Meat?

cues.text: Let's explore a hypothetical together.
cues.en: Let's explore a hypothetical together.
cues.zh: 讓我們一起來探討一個假想情境。

cues.text: There are over four times as many livestock as people.
cues.en: There are over four times as many livestock as people.
cues.zh: 家畜的數量是人類的四倍以上。

cues.text: Farmed cattle alone weigh nearly ten times as much
cues.en: Farmed cattle alone weigh nearly ten times as much
cues.zh: 單單養殖牛的總重量幾乎就是 所有野生哺乳類動物加總的十倍。

cues.text: as all wild mammals combined.
cues.en: as all wild mammals combined.
cues.zh: 想像一下，如果突然 出現了一名無肉餐飲巫師，

cues.text: So imagine if a wizard of meatless dining suddenly appeared
cues.en: So imagine if a wizard of meatless dining suddenly appeared
cues.zh: 想像一下，如果突然 出現了一名無肉餐飲巫師，

cues.text: and with one wave of a wand wiped away all meat from our shelves—
cues.en: and with one wave of a wand wiped away all meat from our shelves—
cues.zh: 一揮魔杖就讓我們架上 所有肉類都消失無蹤，

cues.text: along with any desire to eat it.
cues.en: along with any desire to eat it.
cues.zh: 也讓我們沒有吃肉的慾望。

cues.text: Farm animals destined for food vanish— whisked away to another planet.
cues.en: Farm animals destined for food vanish— whisked away to another planet.
cues.zh: 用來供應肉類的養殖場動物消失了——

cues.text: What happens in the following days, years, and even millennia?
cues.en: What happens in the following days, years, and even millennia?
cues.zh: 接下來的幾天、幾年， 甚至幾千年會如何？

cues.text: Overnight, food related greenhouse gas emissions drop by about 63%.
cues.en: Overnight, food related greenhouse gas emissions drop by about 63%.
cues.zh: 一夜之間，與食物相關的 溫室氣體排放量就下降了約 63％。

cues.text: We no longer get protein and key nutrients
cues.en: We no longer get protein and key nutrients
cues.zh: 我們的蛋白質和重要營養素 不再來自約七百億隻雞、

cues.text: from the approximately 70 billion chickens, 1.5 billion pigs,
cues.en: from the approximately 70 billion chickens, 1.5 billion pigs,
cues.zh: 我們的蛋白質和重要營養素 不再來自約七百億隻雞、

cues.text: 300 million cattle, and 200 million tons of fish and shellfish
cues.en: 300 million cattle, and 200 million tons of fish and shellfish
cues.zh: 三億頭牛，和兩億噸 魚類和甲殼類水生動物，

cues.text: processed for consumption each year.
cues.en: processed for consumption each year.
cues.zh: 這是每年被加工成食品的動物數量。

cues.text: To help fill this nutritional gap,
cues.en: To help fill this nutritional gap,
cues.zh: 為了補足這些少掉的營養，

cues.text: our demand for fruits, vegetables, and legumes go up—
cues.en: our demand for fruits, vegetables, and legumes go up—
cues.zh: 我們對水果、蔬菜， 和豆類的需求增加——

cues.text: a diet that most dietitians agree contains all of the nutrients we need
cues.en: a diet that most dietitians agree contains all of the nutrients we need
cues.zh: 大多數營養師都認同這類飲食

cues.text: for a healthy life.
cues.en: for a healthy life.
cues.zh: 但最初，這類食物的 數量不夠滿足需求。

cues.text: But initially there aren’t enough of these foods to go around.
cues.en: But initially there aren’t enough of these foods to go around.
cues.zh: 但最初，這類食物的 數量不夠滿足需求。

cues.text: The rise in demand causes produce costs to soar.
cues.en: The rise in demand causes produce costs to soar.
cues.zh: 需求的上升導致農產品成本飆升。

cues.text: In regions like Mongolia,
cues.en: In regions like Mongolia,
cues.zh: 在像蒙古這樣的地區，

cues.text: where the harsh environment makes it difficult to grow vegetables,
cues.en: where the harsh environment makes it difficult to grow vegetables,
cues.zh: 因為環境惡劣，種植蔬菜十分困難，

cues.text: a sudden lack of meat leaves people with little to eat.
cues.en: a sudden lack of meat leaves people with little to eat.
cues.zh: 肉類突然消失，讓大家 幾乎沒東西可以吃。

cues.text: Cultures built around meat lose their foundations.
cues.en: Cultures built around meat lose their foundations.
cues.zh: 以肉類為中心建立的 文化失去了基礎。

cues.text: Members of salmon-eating tribes in the Pacific Northwest of the United States,
cues.en: Members of salmon-eating tribes in the Pacific Northwest of the United States,
cues.zh: 例如，在美國太平洋西北部， 吃鮭魚的部落族人

cues.text: for example, lose not only sustenance and livelihoods,
cues.en: for example, lose not only sustenance and livelihoods,
cues.zh: 不僅失去了糧食和生計，

cues.text: but an integral component of their religion.
cues.en: but an integral component of their religion.
cues.zh: 也失去了其宗教的一大要素。

cues.text: Tens of millions of anglers lose work that was already threatened
cues.en: Tens of millions of anglers lose work that was already threatened
cues.zh: 數千萬名垂釣者失去了

cues.text: by dwindling fish populations.
cues.en: by dwindling fish populations.
cues.zh: 本來就已經因為魚類數量減少 而受到威脅的工作。

cues.text: As the meat industry collapses,
cues.en: As the meat industry collapses,
cues.zh: 隨著肉類產業瓦解，

cues.text: many households in developing countries are left scrambling for income
cues.en: many households in developing countries are left scrambling for income
cues.zh: 發展中國家的許多家庭

cues.text: that once came from livestock farming.
cues.en: that once came from livestock farming.
cues.zh: 因為失去原本來自畜牧業的 收入而陷入辛苦掙扎。

cues.text: Some meat producers shift to agricultural crops,
cues.en: Some meat producers shift to agricultural crops,
cues.zh: 有些肉類生產者轉型改種農作物，

cues.text: which leave workers— and neighboring communities—
cues.en: which leave workers— and neighboring communities—
cues.zh: 導致工人——以及鄰近社群——

cues.text: less susceptible to respiratory diseases associated with livestock production.
cues.en: less susceptible to respiratory diseases associated with livestock production.
cues.zh: 比較不會受到畜牧生產 相關的呼吸系統疾病所影響。

cues.text: As crop agriculture expands, prices come down.
cues.en: As crop agriculture expands, prices come down.
cues.zh: 隨著作物農業的擴大，價格會下降。

cues.text: Ultimately, vegetarianism becomes less expensive than meat-eating
cues.en: Ultimately, vegetarianism becomes less expensive than meat-eating
cues.zh: 最終，在大部分國家， 吃素變得比吃肉便宜。

cues.text: in most countries.
cues.en: in most countries.
cues.zh: 幸運的是，我們並不必開墾 新的農地來種植所有這些食物。

cues.text: Luckily, we don’t need to clear new farmland to grow all this food.
cues.en: Luckily, we don’t need to clear new farmland to grow all this food.
cues.zh: 幸運的是，我們並不必開墾 新的農地來種植所有這些食物。

cues.text: Without animals raised for meat,
cues.en: Without animals raised for meat,
cues.zh: 沒有為了食用而飼養的動物，

cues.text: land that had been used to grow feed is now available.
cues.en: land that had been used to grow feed is now available.
cues.zh: 以前用來種飼料的土地 現在空下來可供使用。

cues.text: All things considered, our new diets require less land and water.
cues.en: All things considered, our new diets require less land and water.
cues.zh: 綜合來看，我們的新飲食 所需要的土地和水都較少。

cues.text: Millions of deaths are avoided every year,
cues.en: Millions of deaths are avoided every year,
cues.zh: 每年可以避免數百萬人死亡，

cues.text: thanks in part to lower rates of heart disease, cancer,
cues.en: thanks in part to lower rates of heart disease, cancer,
cues.zh: 有部分原因是因為 較少人患有心臟病、癌症，

cues.text: and other conditions associated with red meat consumption.
cues.en: and other conditions associated with red meat consumption.
cues.zh: 以及其他和吃紅肉相關的疾病。

cues.text: We no longer contract new pathogens from wild animals hunted for food,
cues.en: We no longer contract new pathogens from wild animals hunted for food,
cues.zh: 我們不再因為捕殺野生動物 而染上新的病原體，

cues.text: or novel influenza viruses from farmed pigs,
cues.en: or novel influenza viruses from farmed pigs,
cues.zh: 或因為養豬而染上新型的流感病毒，

cues.text: or drug-resistant superbugs that develop in beef cattle
cues.en: or drug-resistant superbugs that develop in beef cattle
cues.zh: 或在被餵食預防性 抗生素的食用牛身上

cues.text: that have been preemptively fed antibiotics.
cues.en: that have been preemptively fed antibiotics.
cues.zh: 產生的高抗藥性超級細菌。

cues.text: As the years pass, global biodiversity rises
cues.en: As the years pass, global biodiversity rises
cues.zh: 隨時間過去，全球的 生物多樣性越來越高，

cues.text: as habitat loss, pesticide use, and other pressures from agriculture subside.
cues.en: as habitat loss, pesticide use, and other pressures from agriculture subside.
cues.zh: 因為棲息地喪失、 殺蟲劑使用的情況減少，

cues.text: Amazonian birds have more forest to fly over.
cues.en: Amazonian birds have more forest to fly over.
cues.zh: 亞馬遜的鳥類有更多森林可以飛翔。

cues.text: Fewer cheetahs are shot for stalking too close to livestock.
cues.en: Fewer cheetahs are shot for stalking too close to livestock.
cues.zh: 也比較少有獵豹因為 跟蹤牲畜時太過靠近而被槍殺。

cues.text: Bee, wasp, and butterfly communities thrive as natural areas expand.
cues.en: Bee, wasp, and butterfly communities thrive as natural areas expand.
cues.zh: 隨著自然區域的擴大，蜜蜂、 黃蜂，和蝴蝶群落都蓬勃發展。

cues.text: In turn, insect-pollinated crops produce higher yields.
cues.en: In turn, insect-pollinated crops produce higher yields.
cues.zh: 接下來，昆蟲授粉的作物產量更高。

cues.text: Many ocean species rebound from overfishing.
cues.en: Many ocean species rebound from overfishing.
cues.zh: 本來因過度捕撈的許多 海洋物種重新復甦，

cues.text: Throughout history, humans in traditionally vegetarian regions
cues.en: Throughout history, humans in traditionally vegetarian regions
cues.zh: 在歷史上，傳統素食地區的人類

cues.text: have evolved a genetic mutation
cues.en: have evolved a genetic mutation
cues.zh: 已經演化出一種基因突變，

cues.text: that helps them more efficiently process fats from plants.
cues.en: that helps them more efficiently process fats from plants.
cues.zh: 讓他們能更有效地處理 來自植物的脂肪。

cues.text: So over thousands of years,
cues.en: So over thousands of years,
cues.zh: 因此，經過數千年，

cues.text: our bodies may evolve to make the most of our veggies.
cues.en: our bodies may evolve to make the most of our veggies.
cues.zh: 我們的身體可能演化成 能充分利用我們的蔬菜。

cues.text: Or we may lose some adaptations, like the ability to extract iron from meat.
cues.en: Or we may lose some adaptations, like the ability to extract iron from meat.
cues.zh: 或我們可能會失去一些適應能力， 例如從肉中提取鐵質的能力。

cues.text: Of course, a wizard will not turn our world meatless.
cues.en: Of course, a wizard will not turn our world meatless.
cues.zh: 當然，巫師不會把我們的 世界變成無肉世界。

cues.text: Though many individuals are choosing to go vegetarian,
cues.en: Though many individuals are choosing to go vegetarian,
cues.zh: 儘管有許多人選擇吃素，

cues.text: globally, meat eating is still on the rise.
cues.en: globally, meat eating is still on the rise.
cues.zh: 就全球來說，肉食仍在增加。

cues.text: This trend spells trouble for our climate.
cues.en: This trend spells trouble for our climate.
cues.zh: 這個趨勢會給我們的氣候帶來麻煩。

cues.text: Even if we suddenly stopped burning fossil fuels,
cues.en: Even if we suddenly stopped burning fossil fuels,
cues.zh: 即使我們突然停止燃燒化石燃料，

cues.text: business as usual food systems paired with a growing population
cues.en: business as usual food systems paired with a growing population
cues.zh: 一切照舊的食物系統， 加上人口不斷增加，

cues.text: would push global temperatures over 1.5°C by the end of the century.
cues.en: would push global temperatures over 1.5°C by the end of the century.
cues.zh: 會在這個世紀末將全球溫度 推升攝氏一點五度以上。

cues.text: Cattle are the biggest culprit.
cues.en: Cattle are the biggest culprit.
cues.zh: 罪魁禍首是牛。

cues.text: Beef and dairy production are responsible for over 60% of all food-based emissions,
cues.en: Beef and dairy production are responsible for over 60% of all food-based emissions,
cues.zh: 食物相關的排放總量中有至少 60％ 和牛肉及乳製品的生產有關，

cues.text: while only providing around 18% of the world's calories.
cues.en: while only providing around 18% of the world's calories.
cues.zh: 但它們提供的卡路里 僅佔全球的約 18%。

cues.text: In fact, diets containing modest portions of meats like chicken
cues.en: In fact, diets containing modest portions of meats like chicken
cues.zh: 實際上，包含適當肉類 （如雞肉）份量的飲食

cues.text: often produce less greenhouse gas than vegetarian diets high in dairy.
cues.en: often produce less greenhouse gas than vegetarian diets high in dairy.
cues.zh: 產生的溫室氣體通常少於 大量乳製品的素食飲食。

cues.text: Reducing beef, cheese, and milk consumption could go a long way
cues.en: Reducing beef, cheese, and milk consumption could go a long way
cues.zh: 少吃牛肉、乳酪，和牛奶，

cues.text: toward achieving many of the benefits of a meatless world—
cues.en: toward achieving many of the benefits of a meatless world—
cues.zh: 對於協助實現無肉世界的 許多益處都有很大的幫助——

cues.text: no magic required.
cues.en: no magic required.
cues.zh: 不需要魔法就能辦到。
